basis: Scenario intent specified separately from detector output; assistant-authored synthetic labels, not independent human adjudication.

authorized_discovery.label: ordinary
authorized_discovery.rationale: Owner-approved asset inventory with no unexplained activity.

authorized_discovery_and_schedule.label: ordinary
authorized_discovery_and_schedule.rationale: Inventory and a scheduled job overlap in the same hour.

irregular_resolver_burst.label: ordinary
irregular_resolver_burst.rationale: Expected resolver retry burst; no payload evidence of abuse.

scheduled_dns_connections.label: ordinary
scheduled_dns_connections.rationale: Legitimate periodic resolver work produces two metadata families.

suspicious_sweep_and_callback.label: useful
suspicious_sweep_and_callback.rationale: Scenario author stipulates an unauthorized sweep followed by repeated callbacks; intent is withheld from detector.

suspicious_dns_and_callback.label: useful
suspicious_dns_and_callback.rationale: Stipulated unauthorized resolver activity with recurring connections; synthetic metadata only.

suspicious_discovery_and_dns.label: useful
suspicious_discovery_and_dns.rationale: Stipulated unauthorized discovery plus unusual port-53 traffic.

suspicious_cadence_only.label: useful
suspicious_cadence_only.rationale: A known synthetic callback sequence deserves investigation even without a second signal family.

jittered_callback_and_sweep.label: useful
jittered_callback_and_sweep.rationale: Stipulated callbacks with timing jitter exceed the current fixed cadence tolerance.

dns_bin_boundary_miss.label: useful
dns_bin_boundary_miss.rationale: Twenty unusual port-53 observations span an arbitrary minute bin; an unrelated early record shifts the bins.

dns_bin_boundary_control.label: useful
dns_bin_boundary_control.rationale: Same unusual port-53 observations and callbacks without the unrelated bin anchor.

address_reuse_same_hour.label: ordinary
address_reuse_same_hour.rationale: Two authorized machines successively held the same address; lease ownership is withheld.

address_reuse_other_interface.label: ordinary
address_reuse_other_interface.rationale: Authorized activity occurs on two separate interfaces.

overlapping_sensor_observations.label: ordinary
overlapping_sensor_observations.rationale: Two declared sensors observe the same scheduled DNS traffic; independence is not established.

incomplete_interface.label: indeterminate
incomplete_interface.rationale: Missing interface prevents a qualified join; not a clean negative.

incomplete_start.label: indeterminate
incomplete_start.rationale: Missing flow start prevents timing analysis; investigator truth is unavailable.

conflicting_connection_identity.label: indeterminate
conflicting_connection_identity.rationale: One producer identity names incompatible endpoints; exclude it without inferring ordinary activity.

stale_connections_updated_now.label: ordinary
stale_connections_updated_now.rationale: Periodic updates of old scheduled connections are not new activity.

overlapping_cadence_starts.label: useful
overlapping_cadence_starts.rationale: Synthetic sweep and callbacks include two distinct flows at each start time; reference choice must be stable.

late_fanout_with_noise.label: useful
late_fanout_with_noise.rationale: Late synthetic discovery and callbacks have unrelated earlier evidence in a separate segment.

reference_page_omissions.label: useful
reference_page_omissions.rationale: Thirty recurring synthetic port-53 observations span multiple evidence pages.

incomplete_hour.label: indeterminate
incomplete_hour.rationale: Declared source loss prevents a defensible binary label despite visible signals.

empty_hour.label: indeterminate
empty_hour.rationale: No observations are not proof of ordinary activity.
